name: Ariel Vaughn
source:
The stoic and logical knight of the Queen's Guard. Ari rarely shows much emotion to those around him - even his closest friends. He is logical and work-minded, and is a little awkward with people he doesn't know well. What will it take to stir the heart of someone who seems to try so hard to keep his emotions at bay?

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/steamberrystudio/gilded-shadows-a-gxb-sci-fi-adventure-otome-game]Kickstarter[/url]]
